game.hint: WASD: move    Left Click: swipe    E: inventory    Esc: pause    F4: debug

dialogue.wanderer: The stars don't fall by accident, you know. Every core you find used to be something bigger.
dialogue.scout: Push far enough west and the ground starts smoking. Nothing's followed it back here yet.

quest.offer: Scrap's piling up out there and I've no hands free to gather it. Bring me {count} {item} and I'll see you're compensated.
quest.offerKill: Enemies keep pressing in from the wilds. Cull {count} of them and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.doneKill: Good work. That's a few less to worry about.
